q: Logging Service 基础需求包含哪些点？（多选）
q_en: Which base requirements does the Logging Service need? (Select all)
options: 五个级别 DEBUG < INFO < WARN < ERROR < FATAL
每条记录包含 timestamp、level、message、threadName
每个 destination 有自己的 minLevel 和 formatter
并发写同一 destination 时字节不能交错
why: 题目重点是同步日志库的核心模型和并发写安全。异步、热更新、远程目的地和层级 logger 是后续扩展。
why_en: The base logger has ordered levels, immutable records, per-destination thresholds and formats, and non-interleaved concurrent writes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 五值有序枚举 DEBUG<INFO<WARN<ERROR<FATAL，用于记录严重度和 destination 的阈值比较。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LogLevel is the five-value ordered enum from DEBUG to FATAL used for severity and threshold comparisons.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每个 destination 自己配置的最低级别阈值，记录级别低于它就被静默丢弃。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: minLevel is the per-destination threshold below which a record is silently dropped.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 LogRecord 序列化成字符串的策略接口，PlainText 和 JSON 是两个实现，和输出目标无关。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Formatter is a strategy interface that serializes a LogRecord into a string, independent of the output target.

termDefinitions.meaning: 产生这条日志的线程名，在 Logger.log 顶部随 timestamp 一起只捕获一次。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: threadName is the emitting thread's name, captured once at the top of Logger.log alongside the timestamp.

options_en: Five ordered levels: DEBUG below INFO below WARN below ERROR below FATAL.
Every record carries a timestamp, level, message, and thread name.
Each destination has its own minimum level and formatter.
Concurrent writes to the same destination must never interleave bytes.
optionExplanations: 有序级别防止候选人漏掉阈值比较的基础——没有顺序就无法判断哪些消息该被过滤掉。
固定字段集合避免每次调用都临时拼装不同结构的日志，保证下游解析一致。
独立配置让同一条记录能在 console 详细、在 file 只留警戒线以上，互不牵连。
防止两个线程同时写导致同一行文件里混进另一条消息的字节，日志变成乱码。
optionExplanations_en: An ordered level enum is what makes per-destination threshold filtering possible in the first place.
A fixed field set keeps every log line parseable the same way instead of ad hoc per-call shapes.
Per-destination settings let the same record show up verbosely on console but sparsely in the file.
It stops two threads' writes from splicing together mid-line into unreadable garbled output.
scenario: 45 分钟 LLD 面试：设计进程内日志库，多线程调用、多个输出目标，先只做同步版。
scenario_en: In a 45-minute LLD round you design an in-process logging library: many threads calling it, several output destinations, synchronous only for now.

q: 最合适的建模是什么？
q_en: What is the best model for this data?
options: 不可变 LogRecord 值对象
四个参数到处传
Destination 内部临时拼接全局变量
每个字段单独一个类
why: 这些字段总是一起出现、一起格式化，建成不可变记录能稳定方法签名。未来加 requestId 也只改记录结构。
why_en: LogRecord groups per-call data into one immutable value object that all destinations consume.
whenOtherWins: 非常小的脚本可直接传参数，但库设计中记录对象更稳。
tradeoff: 不可变值对象 vs 到处传递散装参数

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次 log 调用生成的不可变值对象，携带 timestamp、level、message、threadName 四个字段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A LogRecord is the immutable value object created per log call, carrying timestamp, level, message, and thread name.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个已配置的输出目标，组合 minLevel、Formatter 和 Sink，负责过滤、格式化、加锁写入的完整流程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Destination is one configured output target that composes a threshold, a formatter, and a sink to filter, format, and write under a lock.

options_en: An immutable LogRecord value object.
Pass the four fields around as loose parameters everywhere.
Have Destination stitch together global variables on the fly.
Give every field its own dedicated class.
optionExplanations: LogRecord 把四个字段打包成一份不可变快照，所有 destination 读同一份数据，未来加字段也只改这一个类。
把四个参数散着传，方法签名会随字段增长不断变化，调用点到处要改。
让 Destination 现拼字段等于把状态创建逻辑复制到每个目的地，容易各写各的、字段不一致。
每个字段单独建类只会增加对象数量，字段本就一起出现、一起格式化，没必要拆开。
optionExplanations_en: LogRecord bundles the four fields into one immutable snapshot that every destination reads, so adding a field later only touches this class.
Passing four loose parameters means every signature grows and every call site breaks whenever a field is added.
Having each Destination assemble its own state duplicates record-building logic and risks inconsistent fields across destinations.
Giving every field its own class just multiplies objects — the fields always travel and format together, so splitting them adds nothing.

q: LogRecord 字段为什么应只读？
q_en: Why should LogRecord fields be read-only?
options: 只读字段能让 CPU 缓存命中率更高，因此被误当作写入更快的必要条件
一条日志代表某时刻事实，destination/formatter 不应互相竞态修改它
Formatter 序列化时经常需要就地改写 message 字段以适配不同格式
threadName 应该在写入不同 destination 时重新捕获一次，才算准确
why: 不可变记录可安全地被多个 destination 和 formatter 读取。它也让格式化可以在锁外并行执行。
why_en: Immutable log records can be safely shared across destinations and formatted concurrently.
tradeoff: 不可变字段换并发安全 vs 可变字段换原地修改的灵活性

options_en: Read-only fields improve CPU cache hits, so they're mistaken for a write-speed requirement.
A log record represents a fact at one moment, and destinations/formatters must not race to mutate it.
A formatter needs to rewrite the message field in place to match different output formats.
ThreadName should be recaptured each time the record reaches a different destination.
optionExplanations: 缓存命中率是真实存在的次要好处，但把它当成不可变的理由本末倒置——真正原因是并发安全，不是性能。
抓住了要点——同一条记录本该是固定事实，谁都不该在旁路上改写它。
Formatter 不该就地改 message；它只应该读取字段生成一份新的格式化字符串。
重新捕获 threadName 会让同一次调用在不同 destination 看到不一致的线程名，破坏“同一事实”的前提。
optionExplanations_en: Cache locality is a real side effect, but citing it as the reason mistakes a minor perk for the actual concurrency motive.
Correctly names the reason: a record is a fixed fact, and no destination should be racing to rewrite it.
A formatter should never rewrite the message in place — it only reads fields to produce a new formatted string.
Recapturing threadName per destination would let the same call show different thread names, breaking the single-fact guarantee.
scenario: 同一条 LogRecord 会被 console 和 file 两个 destination 在不同线程上同时读取和格式化。
scenario_en: The same LogRecord is read and formatted by a console and a file destination on two different threads at once.

scenario: 一条 log 调用会写到 console 和 file 两个 destination。
scenario_en: One log call writes to both a console destination and a file destination.
q: timestamp 和 threadName 应在哪里捕获？
q_en: Where should timestamp and threadName be captured?
options: 每个 Destination.write 方法内部各自单独捕获
每个 Formatter.format 内捕获
Logger.log 顶部，只创建一次 LogRecord
FileSink.write 后捕获
why: 同一次 log 调用的所有目的地应看到同一条记录和同一时间点。放在 destination 内会造成同一记录不同时间戳。
why_en: Logger.log captures timestamp and thread name once so every destination sees the same record.
whenOtherWins: 如果目的地需要记录实际写入时间，可以额外加 emittedAt/writeTime，但不能替代事件时间。
tradeoff: 调用处一次性捕获 vs 每个 destination/formatter 各自捕获

termDefinitions.meaning: Sink 的一个实现，构造时打开并复用一个文件句柄，把格式化字符串追加写入文件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FileSink is a Sink implementation that opens a file handle once and appends formatted strings to it.

options_en: Capture separately inside each Destination.write method, on its own each time.
Capture separately inside each Formatter.format.
Capture once at the top of Logger.log and build one LogRecord.
Capture only after FileSink.write finishes.
optionExplanations: 放进每个 Destination.write 会让同一次调用在不同目的地留下不同时间戳，破坏“同一事件”的前提。

抓住了关键——在调用入口就把时间和线程名定格一次，所有目的地共享同一份记录。
FileSink.write 之后捕获意味着记录已经写完才决定内容，时序完全反了。
optionExplanations_en: Capturing inside each Destination.write gives the same call different timestamps per destination, breaking the single-event guarantee.
A formatter only serializes — putting capture there still lets each destination see a different timestamp.
Nails it: capture time and thread once at the call entry so every destination shares the exact same record.
Capturing after FileSink.write means the content is decided only after it's already written — the order is backwards.

q: 最终模型包含哪些核心类型？（多选）
q_en: Which core types are in the final model? (Select all)
options: Logger
LogRecord
Formatter
Destination
Sink
LogLevel
why: Logger 编排，LogRecord 携带数据，Formatter 序列化，Sink 输出字节，Destination 组合阈值/格式/输出并加锁。

LogRecord, the immutable data unit.

optionExplanations: 唯一入口把调用打包成记录并 fan-out，调用方不用关心有几个目的地。

q: Logger 应保存什么状态？
q_en: What state should Logger keep?

当前 threadName
所有日志文本历史

why_en: Logger only needs an immutable destination list because configuration is fixed at startup.

tradeoff: 启动时固定的不可变列表 vs 支持运行时增删的可变配置

q_en: Why should Formatter be separate from Destination?
options: 格式和输出目标是两个独立变化轴，分离可避免 N×M 类爆炸
Formatter 需要自己持有并管理文件句柄
Destination 内部无法比较 LogLevel 大小
JSON 格式只能被写到 console 里
why: PlainText/JSON 可以配 Console/File/Remote 任意组合。把格式抽成策略，新增格式不改输出目标。
why_en: Formatter separates serialization from output target and prevents a format-by-destination class explosion.
tradeoff: 格式与输出目标独立变化 vs 耦合成 N×M 个类

q_en: How should Destination.write handle it?
options: 捕获异常，写 stderr 诊断并返回，不让异常逃到业务代码
让 sink.write 抛出的异常一路冒泡到调用 logger.error 的业务代码

把这个 sink 出错之后所有已配置的 destination 永久关闭，不再接受写入

whenOtherWins: 极简实现可吞掉异常，但生产上最好有 stderr 或内部 status logger，并做限流。
tradeoff: 捕获+诊断保证隔离与可观测 vs 直接冒泡保证实现最简单

One destination failing should immediately stop iterating over the remaining destinations.
A single sink failure should permanently disable every configured destination.
optionExplanations: 磁盘满时捕获异常、写 stderr 诊断再正常返回，业务代码完全不知道这次写失败了，但故障仍可被发现。

Aborting the loop means a healthy destination like console also misses records it should have received.

q: 完全吞掉 sink.write 异常的风险是什么？

why_en: Swallowing sink failures silently can hide broken logging for a long time.
tradeoff: 吞异常保护调用方 vs 完全静默丢失可观测性

把 flush() 调用放进 Formatter.format 方法里执行

tradeoff: 更及时的 flush 换崩溃前可见 vs 只在 close 时 flush 换更少 I/O

q: 为什么 Logger 不在全局层面按 level 过滤？

因为 Logger.log 这个方法本身完全没有设计 level 参数可供全局过滤使用

whenOtherWins: 如果要求严格顺序或不丢日志，需要队列、持久化缓冲和更复杂的失败策略。
tradeoff: 字节级原子写不丢交错 vs 更强的不丢日志/严格排序保证

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个已配置的输出目标，组合 minLevel、Formatter 和 Sink，负责过滤、格式化、加锁写入的完整流程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Destination is one configured output target that composes a threshold, a formatter, and a sink to filter, format, and write under a lock.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只负责把已经格式化好的字符串写到具体目标（stdout、文件、未来的网络）的窄接口，不做过滤或格式化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Sink is a narrow interface that only writes an already formatted string to a target like stdout, a file, or the network.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每个 destination 自己配置的最低级别阈值，记录级别低于它就被静默丢弃。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: minLevel is the per-destination threshold below which a record is silently dropped.

options_en: On one Destination, each sink.write is atomic relative to other writes, so record bytes never interleave.
The design guarantees log records are never lost or corrupted under any circumstance.
The design guarantees every thread's writes land strictly ordered by log() call time.
The design requires every destination to be configured with the exact same minLevel threshold for it to work at all.
optionExplanations: 准确概括了这个系统真正承诺的东西——同一 destination 上的写入互相原子，字节不会交错。
不丢日志是比这更强的保证，这套设计从没做出这个承诺，sink 失败时记录确实会没写进去。
严格的全局调用顺序需要额外的排序机制，per-destination 锁只保证单目标内不交错，管不了跨线程时序。
minLevel 本来就该按 destination 各自配置，console 详细、file 简洁正是这个设计想要的效果。
optionExplanations_en: Sums up exactly what this system actually promises: writes to the same destination are atomic relative to each other, no interleaving.
Never losing a record is a stronger guarantee than this design makes — a sink failure genuinely means that record never lands.
Strict global ordering needs extra sequencing machinery — a per-destination lock only stops interleaving on one target, not cross-thread timing.
minLevel is meant to be configured per destination — console being verbose while file stays terse is exactly the intended effect.

q: 中级答案在本题最应稳定识别什么？
q_en: What should a mid-level answer reliably identify in this problem?
options: 候选人必须在这道题里实现出 Log4j 的全部生产功能
Formatter 和输出目标应分离，用组合避免 N×M 类组合
候选人必须在这套设计里额外支持跨服务的分布式日志聚合
候选人必须选择用继承而不是组合来连接 Formatter 和输出目标
why: 需求明确“格式和目的地独立变化”。中级候选人应能快速拆成 Formatter 与目标抽象。
why_en: A mid-level answer should separate formatting from output targets to avoid class explosion.
tradeoff: 组合避免 N×M 爆炸 vs 继承更直觉但耦合更重

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 LogRecord 序列化成字符串的策略接口，PlainText 和 JSON 是两个实现，和输出目标无关。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Formatter is a strategy interface that serializes a LogRecord into a string, independent of the output target.

options_en: The candidate must reimplement all of Log4j's production features.
Formatter and the output target should be separated, using composition to avoid an N-by-M class explosion.
The candidate must add cross-service distributed log aggregation.
The candidate must connect Formatter and output target with inheritance.
optionExplanations: 实现出 Log4j 的全部功能远超这道题的范围，中级候选人不需要做到这个程度。
抓住了这道题真正想考的能力——看出格式和目的地是两条独立轴，用组合拆开避免类爆炸。
跨服务日志聚合是分布式系统的话题，不是这道单机 logger 设计题要考的内容。
继承并不是唯一或更优的连接方式，组合恰恰是这道题想要候选人识别出的更好选择。
optionExplanations_en: Reimplementing all of Log4j's features is far beyond this problem's scope — nowhere near what a mid-level answer needs.
Nails what this problem is actually testing: recognizing format and target as independent axes and separating them via composition.
Cross-service log aggregation is a distributed-systems topic, not what this single-process logger design problem is testing.
Inheritance isn't the only or the better way to connect them — composition is precisely the choice this problem wants recognized.
scenario: 评分表要求：中级候选人须从“格式与目的地各自独立变化”这条需求推出类结构。
scenario_en: The rubric expects a mid-level candidate to derive the class structure from the requirement that format and destination vary independently.

scenario: 有人想给 Logger 暴露 addDestination、removeDestination、reloadConfig。
scenario_en: Someone wants Logger to expose addDestination, removeDestination, and reloadConfig.
q: 基础需求下应该怎么做？
q_en: What should you do for the base requirements?
options: 把 addDestination、removeDestination、reloadConfig 全部实现出来以显示功能完整
把 addDestination 这类配置方法直接定义在 LogRecord 类上
不暴露；配置启动时固定，保持 destinations immutable
让 Sink 接口反过来持有并修改 Logger 的配置状态
why: YAGNI：热更新明确 out of scope。不可变配置简化并发遍历和 API。
why_en: Since configuration is fixed at startup, keeping destinations immutable avoids unnecessary concurrency complexity.
whenOtherWins: 如果需求加入热更新，可用原子替换 destination 列表或配置管理器。
tradeoff: YAGNI 保持不可变 vs 提前实现热更新换灵活性

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个已配置的输出目标，组合 minLevel、Formatter 和 Sink，负责过滤、格式化、加锁写入的完整流程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Destination is one configured output target that composes a threshold, a formatter, and a sink to filter, format, and write under a lock.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次 log 调用生成的不可变值对象，携带 timestamp、level、message、threadName 四个字段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A LogRecord is the immutable value object created per log call, carrying timestamp, level, message, and thread name.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只负责把已经格式化好的字符串写到具体目标（stdout、文件、未来的网络）的窄接口，不做过滤或格式化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Sink is a narrow interface that only writes an already formatted string to a target like stdout, a file, or the network.

termDefinitions.meaning: 日志库的唯一入口类，持有不可变 destinations 列表，把每次调用打包成 LogRecord 并 fan-out 给每个 destination。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Logger is the single entry point that builds one LogRecord per call and fans it out to every configured destination.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种工程原则：不要为当下还不需要的功能预先建设复杂度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: YAGNI, short for You Aren't Gonna Need It, argues against building complexity for a requirement you don't have yet.

options_en: Implementing all three methods shows completeness.
AddDestination-style methods belong on LogRecord.
Don't expose them; configuration is fixed at startup and destinations stay immutable.
Sink should hold and mutate Logger's configuration.
optionExplanations: 全部实现出来会带来热更新的并发复杂度，而这正是需求明确排除在范围外的东西。
配置方法管的是 Logger 的目的地列表，跟 LogRecord 这个一次性数据快照毫不相干。
需求已经明说热更新不在范围内，配置在启动时钉死、destinations 保持不可变，API 和并发遍历都更简单。
让 Sink 反过来持有并修改 Logger 配置会把依赖方向倒转，输出接口不该管理它的调用方。
optionExplanations_en: Implementing all three brings in hot-reload's concurrency complexity — exactly what the requirements explicitly ruled out.
Configuration methods manage Logger's destination list — completely unrelated to LogRecord, a one-shot data snapshot.
The requirements already rule out hot-reload, so locking configuration at startup keeps both the API and concurrent iteration simpler.
Having Sink hold and mutate Logger's config inverts the dependency direction — an output interface shouldn't manage its caller.

scenario: 面试官只说「设计一个 logging service」。你先问：是应用链接进来的进程内库，还是把日志经网络送到中央聚合器？回答是进程内库，只写 stdout 和本地文件。
scenario_en: The prompt is just "design a logging service." You ask whether it is an in-process library or something that ships logs over the network to a central aggregator. The answer: in-process library, writing to stdout and local files only.
q: 这一个回答砍掉了哪整块设计工作？
q_en: Which whole block of design work does that one answer remove?
options: 传输层整块：队列、schema 版本管理、跨服务分发都不用设计
五个严重级别的枚举可以省掉，进程内不需要区分严重度
线程安全可以不做，因为进程内的调用天然就是单线程的
格式化必须和目的地类型绑成同一个类，因为进程内不会出现远程目的地这种情况
options_en: The whole transport layer: queues, schema versioning, and cross-service delivery all disappear.
The five-level severity enum can be dropped; an in-process library needs no severity.
Thread safety can be skipped, because in-process calls are single-threaded by nature.
Formatting must be fused into the destination class, since a remote target can never appear in-process.
optionExplanations: 交付物缩成一个跑在单进程里的对象模型，写本地目标，摄取管线归别人。
级别和进程边界无关，需求明确要五级并有大小顺序。
恰恰相反：同进程多线程会同时调 log，锁是设计的一部分。
需求说格式与目的地类型各自独立变化，绑一起会退回 N×M 类爆炸。
optionExplanations_en: The deliverable shrinks to an object model inside one process writing to local targets; ingestion is someone else's problem.
Severity has nothing to do with the process boundary; five ordered levels are required.
The opposite: many threads in the same process call log concurrently, so locking is part of the design.
The requirements say format and target vary independently; fusing them brings back the N×M class explosion.
why: 进程内意味着共享状态只剩本进程的文件句柄和 stdout，传输与聚合整块消失；代价是这套库天生不具备跨服务汇总能力。
why_en: In-process means the only shared state is this process's file handle and stdout, so the whole transport and aggregation layer drops out of scope.
tradeoff: 进程内库的对象模型 vs 网络聚合服务的管线设计
whenOtherWins: 若回答是网络聚合服务，队列、摄取 schema、背压才是主设计，进程内的对象模型反而是次要话题。

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次调用把同一条数据分发给多个下游接收者，这里指一次 log 调用写进所有已配置的 destination。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Fan-out means one call delivers the same item to multiple downstream receivers — here, one log call reaching every configured destination.

termDefinitions.meaning: 集中约定日志或消息的字段结构与版本，让生产方和消费方对同一份结构达成一致。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Schema versioning centrally pins the field structure of messages so producers and consumers agree on one shape.

termDefinitions.meaning: 进程的标准输出流，控制台日志默认写到这里。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Stdout is a process's standard output stream, where console logs are written by default.

scenario: 为了让 log() 不阻塞调用方，你给每个 destination 配一个有界队列和一个专属 worker 线程；worker 是唯一取记录并写 sink 的线程。
scenario_en: To keep log() non-blocking you put a bounded queue in front of each destination plus one dedicated worker thread; that worker is the only thread that drains the queue and writes to the sink.
q: sink 上那把 per-destination 锁还需要留着吗？
q_en: Do you still need the per-destination lock around the sink?
options: 还需要，队列本身并不能阻止字节交错
可以去掉；单消费者独占 sink，但两个 destination 共享同一底层 stream 时要加回来
可以永久去掉；一旦引入队列，无论多少个 destination 指向同一个文件都不会再出现并发写问题
锁和队列解决的是同一个问题，二选一即可，选哪个只取决于团队代码风格
options_en: Keep it — a queue by itself does not stop bytes from interleaving.
Drop it; a single consumer owns the sink — but add it back when two destinations share one underlying stream.
Drop it permanently; once there is a queue, no number of destinations pointing at the same file can race.
Locks and queues solve the same problem, so pick either one based on team style.
optionExplanations: 在单消费者结构下没有第二个线程碰 sink，交错的前提已经不存在了。
只有 worker 线程碰 sink，互斥自动成立；共享底层 stream 时两个 worker 又会撞上。
两个 destination 各有一个 worker，它们写同一个文件时仍是两个线程在竞争。
锁管的是字节不交错的正确性，队列管的是调用方不被阻塞的协调，不可互换。
optionExplanations_en: With a single consumer no second thread touches the sink, so the premise for interleaving is already gone.
Only the worker touches the sink, so mutual exclusion is free — until two workers share one stream.
Each destination has its own worker; pointed at the same file, that is still two threads racing.
The lock is about bytes not interleaving; the queue is about not blocking the caller — not interchangeable.
why: 锁解决正确性、队列解决协调，是两个问题：单消费者让互斥变多余，但共享底层 stream 会把正确性问题原样带回来。
why_en: The lock is about correctness and the queue is about coordination; a single consumer makes the lock redundant until two destinations share one underlying stream.
tradeoff: 锁保证字节不交错 vs 队列保证调用方不阻塞
whenOtherWins: 两个 destination 写同一个底层 stream 时，各自的 worker 仍会互相交错，必须把锁加回来。

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个已配置的输出目标，组合 minLevel、Formatter 和 Sink，负责过滤、格式化、加锁写入的完整流程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Destination is one configured output target that composes a threshold, a formatter, and a sink to filter, format, and write under a lock.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只负责把已格式化好的字符串写到具体目标（stdout、文件、未来的网络）的窄接口，不做过滤或格式化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Sink is a narrow interface that only writes an already formatted string to a target like stdout, a file, or the network.

termDefinitions.meaning: 容量有上限的队列，满了以后必须明确选择阻塞、丢新、丢旧还是抛异常。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A bounded queue has a fixed capacity, so when it fills you must choose explicitly between blocking, dropping, or throwing.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只有一个线程从队列取数据并写下游资源，因此下游资源不会被并发访问。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Single consumer means exactly one thread drains the queue and writes the downstream resource, so that resource is never touched concurrently.

scenario: Destination 做成抽象基类，ConsoleDestination / FileDestination 只覆写 doWrite。现在要给文件输出加一层缓冲，之后还要再加一层失败重试。
scenario_en: Destination is an abstract base class and ConsoleDestination / FileDestination only override doWrite. Now you need to add buffering to the file output, and later retry on top of that.
q: 这个继承结构在加包装时具体怎么坏掉？
q_en: How exactly does the inheritance hierarchy break when you start wrapping?
options: 缓冲版只能再 subclass 并重抄文件逻辑，叠第二层包装就变成三层继承
抽象基类会让子类绕过 minLevel 过滤，过滤不变量守不住
父类和子类共享大量数据，改一个字段就得同步改每个子类的构造函数和序列化逻辑，重构成本随子类数量线性上升
继承会迫使 Formatter 和 Sink 合并成一个接口，格式与目的地重新耦合
options_en: The buffered version must subclass again and re-copy the file logic; a second wrapper makes it three levels of inheritance.
The abstract base lets subclasses bypass the minLevel filter, so the invariant is not held.
Parent and children share so much data that changing one field forces edits to every subclass constructor and serializer, and the cost grows with subclass count.
Inheritance forces Formatter and Sink to merge into one interface, re-coupling format and target.
optionExplanations: 包装是组合操作，用继承表达就只能层层叠，两个包装要三层类。
恰恰相反：模板方法把过滤和格式化钉在基类，子类只写 doWrite，反而不会漏。
真实情况相反——两个子类和基类不共享任何数据，只继承了一个方法，这才是继承理由薄的地方。
Formatter 与 Sink 的拆分与继承无关，继承版一样可以组合它们。
optionExplanations_en: Wrapping is a composition operation; expressed as inheritance it can only stack, so two wrappers need three levels.
The opposite: template method pins filter and format in the base class, so a subclass author cannot forget them.
Reality is the reverse — the subclasses share no data with the parent, they only inherit one method, which is the thin part.
Splitting Formatter from Sink is orthogonal to inheritance; the inheritance variant composes them too.
why: 继承在这里只买到一个方法的复用、不共享任何数据；而缓冲、重试、多路分发这类包装本质是组合，用继承表达只能层层 subclass。
why_en: Here inheritance only buys the reuse of one method and shares no data, while wrappers like buffering or retry are composition and can only be expressed as more subclassing.
tradeoff: 继承复用一个方法 vs 组合可自由叠加包装
whenOtherWins: 只有两个输出目标、且确定永不需要包装时，模板方法版少一个接口，在面试里同样站得住。

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个已配置的输出目标，组合 minLevel、Formatter 和 Sink，负责过滤、格式化、加锁写入的完整流程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Destination is one configured output target that composes a threshold, a formatter, and a sink to filter, format, and write under a lock.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 LogRecord 序列化成字符串的纯函数接口，现有 PlainText 和 Json 两个实现。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Formatter is a pure-function interface that serializes a LogRecord into a string; plain text and JSON are the two implementations.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只负责把已格式化好的字符串写到具体目标（stdout、文件、未来的网络）的窄接口，不做过滤或格式化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Sink is a narrow interface that only writes an already formatted string to a target like stdout, a file, or the network.

termDefinitions.meaning: 基类写死流程骨架、把变化的一步留成抽象方法给子类填的模式，这里 write 是骨架、doWrite 是那一步。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Template method means the base class fixes the workflow skeleton and leaves one abstract step for subclasses; here write is the skeleton and doWrite is the step.

scenario: 需求里的名词有：application、thread、severity level、timestamp、message、还有每次调用产生的那组数据。你要决定谁配拥有一个类。
scenario_en: The nouns in the requirements are: application, thread, severity level, timestamp, message, and the bundle of data produced per call. You must decide which of them deserves a class.
q: 该用哪条法则做这次筛选？
q_en: Which rule should drive that filtering?
options: 名词只要在需求里出现过就建类，宁多勿漏
拥有状态、强制某条规则、或有独立生命周期，占一条才建类
凡是被多个类读到的名词就建类，比如 timestamp 被每个 formatter 读到，所以它该是类
按需求文档的条目切分，一条需求对应一个类，这样类和需求能一一对上便于评审
options_en: Any noun that appears in the requirements becomes a class; better too many than too few.
Owns state, enforces a rule, or has its own lifecycle — one of those, or it stays a field.
Any noun read by more than one class becomes a class; timestamp is read by every formatter, so it is one.
Split by requirement bullet, one class per requirement, so classes map onto the doc and review is easy.
optionExplanations: 会造出 Application、Thread 这类没有状态也不归我们管的空壳类。
level 是五个固定值、timestamp 和 message 是原始值，三者都不占，所以是字段不是类。
被读到不代表拥有行为；按这条法则每个原始字段都会升格成类。
需求条目和类边界不是同一个维度，一条需求常常只落在某个类的一个方法上。
optionExplanations_en: That mints empty classes like Application and Thread, which own nothing and are outside our system anyway.
Level is five fixed values, timestamp and message are primitives — none qualifies, so all three stay fields.
Being read is not owning behaviour; by that rule every primitive field would become a class.
Requirement bullets and class boundaries are different axes; one bullet often lands on a single method.
why: application 和 thread 的生命周期归操作系统、不进模型；四个字段总是同行同生共死，才让那组数据升格成不可变值对象。
why_en: The application and threads are owned by the OS so we never model them, while the four per-call fields always travel together, which is what earns them one immutable value object.
tradeoff: 建类换封装 vs 保留字段换更小的模型
whenOtherWins: 某个名词现在只是字段，但日后长出自己的规则或独立生命周期时，那时再把它升格成类也不迟。

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次 log 调用生成的不可变值对象，携带 timestamp、level、message、threadName 四个字段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A LogRecord is the immutable value object created per log call, carrying timestamp, level, message, and thread name.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只承载数据、构造后不再变化的对象，可以在多线程间自由共享而不需要同步。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A value object only carries data and never changes after construction, so it can be shared across threads without synchronization.

scenario: Formatter 是只有 format(record) -> String 一个方法的接口，现有 PlainText 和 Json 两个实现，Destination 在构造时收下其中一个。
scenario_en: Formatter is a one-method interface, format(record) -> String, with plain-text and JSON implementations, and a Destination takes one of them as a constructor argument.
q: 这对应哪个模式，扩展轴是什么？
q_en: Which pattern is this, and what is the axis of extension?
options: Strategy：序列化算法藏在接口后，加 CSV 格式只是新增一个实现类
Template Method：基类定好流程骨架，子类只填格式化那一步
Factory：由工厂读配置决定该 new 出哪一个 destination
Decorator：一个 formatter 包住另一个 formatter，一层层叠加装饰，直到拼出最终输出字符串
options_en: Strategy: the serialization algorithm sits behind an interface, so a CSV format is just one new class.
Template Method: the base class fixes the workflow and subclasses fill in the formatting step.
Factory: a factory reads config and decides which destination to instantiate.
Decorator: one formatter wraps another, stacking layer on layer until the final output string is assembled.
optionExplanations: 格式是可替换的算法、在构造时注入，扩展轴就是「再多一种格式」。
那是把 format 做成子类要覆写的钩子，正好是这里被拒绝的耦合方向。
工厂管的是对象怎么造出来，跟一次调用里用哪种序列化算法不是同一件事。
装饰要求包装者和被包装者同接口且能叠加，格式化在这里只用一次，不做叠加。
optionExplanations_en: Format is a swappable algorithm injected at construction; the axis of extension is simply "one more format".
That would make formatting a hook subclasses override — exactly the coupling this design rejects.
A factory governs how objects get built, which is a different question from which serializer runs per call.
Decoration needs wrapper and wrapped to share an interface and stack; formatting runs once here, no stacking.
why: 格式与目的地是两条独立变化的轴，Strategy 把格式那条轴变成一个构造参数；代价是多一个接口和一次间接调用。
why_en: Format and target vary along independent axes, and Strategy turns the format axis into a constructor argument at the cost of one extra interface.
tradeoff: Strategy 多一层间接 vs 硬编码格式少一个接口
whenOtherWins: 如果输出格式永远只有一种，直接在 Destination 里拼字符串更省，此时接口是纯开销。

q: 该不该为 Destination 再加接口？
q_en: Should Destination get an interface of its own?
options: 该加，所有类都面向接口编程才算符合依赖倒置
不加；只有一个实现的接口是为抽象而抽象，依赖倒置已落在 Sink 和 Formatter 上
该加，接口能让 Logger 遍历 destinations 时避开运行时类型判断带来的性能损失
该加，否则将来接入远程输出时必须回头修改 Destination 这个类的内部实现逻辑
options_en: Add it — programming to interfaces everywhere is what dependency inversion means.
No; a one-implementation interface is abstraction for its own sake, and inversion already sits at Sink and Formatter.
Add it so Logger can iterate destinations without paying for runtime type checks.
Add it, otherwise adding a remote output later forces you to edit Destination's internals.
optionExplanations: 依赖倒置是让高层依赖变化点的抽象，不是给每个类配一个接口。
Destination 只有一种合法流程，接口买不到第二个实现，只买到一层间接。
遍历一个同类型列表本来就没有类型判断，这个性能理由不存在。
恰恰相反：远程输出是新增一个 Sink 实现，Destination 一行都不用改。
optionExplanations_en: Dependency inversion means high-level code depends on abstractions at the axes of variation, not one interface per class.
There is only one legal Destination workflow, so the interface buys no second implementation, only indirection.
Iterating a homogeneous list involves no type checks, so that performance argument does not exist.
The opposite: a remote target is a new Sink implementation and Destination stays untouched.
why: 抽象要靠变化点挣来：这里的变化在 Sink 和 Formatter 后面，给 Destination 加接口只多一层间接，还多一个要维护的类型。
why_en: An abstraction has to be earned by a real axis of variation, and here that axis lives behind Sink and Formatter, so an IDestination would only add indirection.
tradeoff: 接口换可替换性 vs 具体类换更少间接层
whenOtherWins: 真出现第二种与「过滤-格式化-加锁-写入」不同流程的 destination 实现时，接口才开始有东西可支撑。

scenario: 库里有 Logger、LogRecord、LogLevel、Formatter、Sink、Destination 六个类型；配置在启动时装配一次，之后成千上万个业务调用点只想打一行日志。
scenario_en: The library exposes Logger, LogRecord, LogLevel, Formatter, Sink, and Destination. Configuration is assembled once at startup, and after that tens of thousands of call sites just want to emit a line.
q: 运行期业务代码应该接触其中哪些类型？
q_en: Which of these should application code touch at runtime?
options: 只有 Logger（加上调用时传的 LogLevel），其余全部藏在它后面
Logger 和 Destination，这样业务代码能按场景临时切换输出目标
Logger 和 Formatter，业务代码最清楚自己该用文本还是 JSON 输出
Sink，跳过 Logger 直接写字节，省掉过滤和格式化这两步的开销以缩短热路径
options_en: Only Logger, plus the LogLevel passed at the call site; everything else hides behind it.
Logger and Destination, so business code can switch output targets per situation.
Logger and Formatter, since business code knows best whether it wants text or JSON.
Sink — write bytes directly, skipping filter and format to shorten the hot path.
optionExplanations: 门面只暴露 log 和五个便捷方法，调用点不需要知道背后有几层。
配置是启动时钉死的，运行期切目的地会把并发遍历和不可变性一起破坏。
格式是每个 destination 自己的配置，让调用点决定会让同一条记录在不同目标上不一致。
绕过 Destination 就绕过了过滤和锁，字节会和别的记录交错在一起。
optionExplanations_en: The facade exposes log plus five convenience methods; call sites never need to know what is behind it.
Configuration is fixed at startup; swapping targets at runtime breaks both immutability and lock-free iteration.
Format is per-destination configuration; letting call sites choose makes one record inconsistent across targets.
Bypassing Destination bypasses the filter and the lock, so bytes interleave with other records.
why: Logger 是应用唯一接触的公共门面，调用点数量决定了暴露面的改动成本；灵活性只保留在启动装配处，那里才 new 出 Sink 和 Formatter。
why_en: Logger is the only public face the application touches, so keeping the surface narrow keeps future changes off tens of thousands of call sites.
tradeoff: 窄门面换低改动成本 vs 宽 API 换调用点灵活性
whenOtherWins: 启动装配代码当然要直接 new 出 Sink、Formatter 和 Destination——那是配置代码，不是运行期调用点。

termDefinitions.meaningEn: A facade exposes a single entry class and hides the collaborating classes behind it, so callers learn only one API.

scenario: 现在 formatter.format() 在锁外执行，临界区只包 sink.write()。同事想把 format 也挪进锁里，理由是 try/finally 只写一段、更好读。
scenario_en: Right now formatter.format() runs outside the lock and the critical section holds only sink.write(). A teammate wants to move format inside so there is a single try/finally and the code reads better.
q: 把格式化放进锁内的代价什么时候才真正显现？
q_en: When does moving formatting inside the lock actually cost you?
options: 任何情况下都不可接受，格式化进锁会直接导致死锁
只有格式化昂贵（大对象 JSON 序列化）且竞争高时，吞吐才明显下滑
只要有两个线程就会显现，因为不可变记录进入锁内会被迫复制一份副本
只有单线程时才显现；多线程下锁会把格式化调度到别的核心上并行执行，反而更快
options_en: It is never acceptable — formatting inside the lock deadlocks.
Only when formatting itself is expensive (JSON-encoding a large object) and contention is high does throughput visibly drop.
Any two threads show it, because an immutable record entering the lock has to be copied.
Only single-threaded runs show it; with threads the lock schedules formatting onto another core, so it is faster.
optionExplanations: 格式化不获取任何别的锁，没有形成环的条件，死锁说法不成立。
临界区变长会把纯 CPU 时间压成串行段，量小的时候完全测不出来。
不可变对象从来不需要复制，这正是它能被多线程共享的原因。
锁只做互斥、不做调度，锁内的工作永远是串行的。
optionExplanations_en: Formatting acquires no other lock, so there is no cycle and no deadlock.
A longer critical section serializes pure CPU work, which is invisible until the work is large and contention high.
Immutable objects are never copied — that is exactly why they can be shared across threads.
A lock provides mutual exclusion, not scheduling; work inside it is always serial.
why: record 不可变、formatter 是纯函数，所以放锁外只为把临界区缩到最小；放锁内换来更简单的代码，代价是把 CPU 时间压进串行段。
why_en: The record is immutable and the formatter is pure, so keeping format outside the lock only shrinks the critical section; moving it in buys simpler code and pays in serialized CPU time.
tradeoff: 小临界区换吞吐 vs 大临界区换代码更简单
whenOtherWins: 格式化便宜、并发不高时，锁内格式化少一处推理负担，在面试里是同样可辩护的答案。

termDefinitions.meaningEn: Formatter is a pure-function interface that serializes a LogRecord into a string; plain text and JSON are the two implementations.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同一时刻只允许一个线程执行的代码段，越短并发吞吐越高。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A critical section is the code only one thread may execute at a time; the shorter it is, the higher the concurrent throughput.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只依赖入参、不读写共享状态的函数，因此多线程同时调用天然安全。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A pure function depends only on its arguments and touches no shared state, so concurrent calls are safe by construction.

scenario: 磁盘写满，FileSink.write 每一次都抛 IOException。Destination 捕获后往 stderr 写一行诊断以免静默失败。服务每秒产生几千条 WARN 记录。
scenario_en: The disk is full, so FileSink.write throws IOException on every call. Destination catches it and writes one diagnostic line to stderr so the failure is not silent. The service emits thousands of WARN records per second.
q: 这个诊断通道接下来会怎样，该怎么收口？
q_en: What happens to that diagnostic channel next, and how do you contain it?
options: 每次失败一行，stderr 被刷爆、真正的报错被淹没；要限流、只报首次或按次数退避
不会出问题，stderr 无缓冲，写入代价可以忽略不计
诊断行会被同一个 destination 的锁自动节流到每秒一条
应该把诊断交回 logger 自己打，这样就能复用已有的 destination 过滤链路来限流，实现上也不必新增任何代码
options_en: One line per failure floods stderr and buries real errors; rate-limit, log only the first, or back off.
No problem — stderr is unbuffered, so the write cost is negligible.
The destination's own lock throttles the diagnostics down to one line per second.
Hand diagnostics back to the logger so the existing destination filter chain rate-limits them, needing no new code at all.
optionExplanations: 故障是持续性的，每条记录都会触发一次诊断，量级和日志量一样大。
问题不在单次成本，而在几千行每秒把运维真正要看的信息冲掉。
锁只保证互斥、不限速，几千个线程排队后照样每条都写出去。
把诊断交回正在失败的那条链路，等于让失败自己记录自己，可能无限递归。
optionExplanations_en: The failure is persistent, so every record triggers one diagnostic — the same volume as the logs themselves.
The issue is not per-write cost but thousands of lines per second washing out what operators need to see.
A lock gives mutual exclusion, not rate limiting; queued threads still each emit their line.
Routing diagnostics back through the failing path makes the failure log itself, risking unbounded recursion.
why: 正常写 → 每次失败都产一行诊断 → stderr 被同一条错误刷满、真实报错被淹没 → 限流/只报首次/退避把可见性救回来，代价是后续不同的失败可能被压掉。
why_en: A persistent sink failure emits one diagnostic per record until stderr is flooded, so you rate-limit or report only the first failure — at the cost of possibly suppressing later, different failures.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只负责把已格式化好的字符串写到具体目标（stdout、文件、未来的网络）的窄接口，不做过滤或格式化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Sink is a narrow interface that only writes an already formatted string to a target like stdout, a file, or the network.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个已配置的输出目标，组合 minLevel、Formatter 和 Sink，负责过滤、格式化、加锁写入的完整流程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Destination is one configured output target that composes a threshold, a formatter, and a sink to filter, format, and write under a lock.

termDefinitions.meaning: 进程的标准错误流，作为已知可用的兜底通道用来报告 sink 自己写不出去这件事。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Stderr is the process's standard error stream, used here as the known-good fallback channel for reporting that a sink itself failed to write.

termDefinitions.meaning: 连续失败时逐步拉长下一次上报或重试的间隔，避免故障期间把通道打满。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Backoff means progressively lengthening the interval between reports or retries so a persistent failure cannot saturate the channel.

termDefinitions.meaning: 底层 I/O 操作失败时抛出的异常，磁盘满、句柄失效都会触发。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An IOException is thrown when an underlying input/output operation fails, for example when the disk is full or a handle is invalid.

scenario: 多个线程同时写同一个 FileDestination，磁盘 I/O 慢，per-destination 锁被持有几十毫秒。需求里异步写明确列在范围之外。
scenario_en: Several threads write to the same file destination, disk I/O is slow, and the per-destination lock is held for tens of milliseconds. Async writes are explicitly out of scope.
q: 拿不到锁的线程在 v1 里该怎么处理？
q_en: In v1, what should a thread do when it cannot get the lock?
options: 用 tryLock，拿不到就丢掉这条记录，保证调用方永不阻塞
就阻塞调用线程直到锁释放，v1 不做超时也不做 tryLock
加超时，超时后把这条记录转投到另一个 destination 上以免丢失
为每次 log 调用起一个线程去等锁，调用方立刻返回，等待被推到后台线程上承担
options_en: Use tryLock and drop the record when it fails, so callers never block.
Just block the calling thread until the lock is free; v1 adds no timeout and no tryLock.
Add a timeout and reroute the record to another destination so it is not lost.
Spawn a thread per log call to wait on the lock, returning immediately and pushing the wait to the background.
optionExplanations: 丢记录恰恰发生在系统压力最大、最需要日志的时刻。
契约是「写到了或没写」，阻塞语义最简单且不丢记录。
目的地是运维配置的输出位置，把记录换个地方写会让日志文件对不上。
每次调用一个线程，成本远超它省下的等待，且顺序更难推理。
optionExplanations_en: Dropping records happens exactly when the system is under most stress and the logs matter most.
The contract is "written or not written", and blocking is the simplest semantics that loses nothing.
A destination is an operator-configured output location; rerouting records makes the files disagree.
A thread per call costs far more than the wait it saves, and ordering becomes harder to reason about.
why: 阻塞是唯一既不丢记录又不引入新机制的选择；代价是慢磁盘的延迟会原样传导给调用线程，这正是异步扩展要解决的问题。
why_en: Blocking is the only option that neither loses records nor introduces new machinery, and it pays by passing slow-disk latency straight to the calling thread.
tradeoff: 阻塞换不丢记录 vs 超时或丢弃换调用方延迟
whenOtherWins: 真要保调用方延迟，正确的做法是给每个 destination 加有界队列和 worker 线程，而不是给锁加超时。

termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Destination is one configured output target that composes a threshold, a formatter, and a sink to filter, format, and write under a lock.

termDefinitions.meaning: 尝试获取锁并立即返回成功或失败的调用，不会让线程挂起等待。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TryLock attempts to take a lock and returns success or failure immediately instead of parking the thread.

termDefinitions.meaning: 多个线程同时争抢同一把锁，未抢到的线程必须等待，等待时间等于持有者的临界区长度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Lock contention is several threads racing for the same lock, where losers wait as long as the holder's critical section.

scenario: PlainTextFormatter 现在把 timestamp、level、threadName、message 硬编码拼成一行。运维希望去掉线程名、换个分隔符，而且不想为此发一次版本。
scenario_en: PlainTextFormatter currently hardcodes the concatenation of timestamp, level, thread name, and message. Operators want the thread name dropped and the separator changed without shipping a new build.
q: 生产实现应该怎么支持这种排版变化？
q_en: How should a production implementation absorb that layout change?
options: 每种排版写一个 Formatter 子类，运维要什么就加一个类
构造函数接受一个模板字符串，例如 {timestamp} {level} [{thread}] {message}
把排版交给 Sink，写入前由它决定字段顺序，因为 sink 最贴近输出目标的格式约定
让 LogRecord 自己实现 toString，排版跟着记录走，所有 formatter 都调用同一个方法拿到最终字符串
options_en: One Formatter subclass per layout; add a class whenever operators want a change.
Take a template string in the constructor, e.g. {timestamp} {level} [{thread}] {message}.
Let the Sink decide field order before writing, since it is closest to the target's conventions.
Give LogRecord a toString so layout travels with the record and every formatter calls that one method.
optionExplanations: 排版是配置维度，用类来表达会让类数量随运维口味无限增长。
模板把「哪些字段、什么顺序、什么分隔符」变成一个可外部配置的参数。
Sink 的职责窄到只把字符串变成字节，让它排版会把格式和目的地重新耦合。
值对象不该决定展示形式，否则 JSON 格式化也会被这一个 toString 绑住。
optionExplanations_en: Layout is a configuration dimension; expressing it as classes makes the class count grow with operator taste.
A template turns which fields, in what order, with which separators into one externally configurable parameter.
A Sink's job is narrowly turning a string into bytes; laying out fields there re-couples format with target.
A value object should not decide presentation, or the JSON formatter gets bound to that same toString.
why: 排版是配置不是代码，模板字符串让输出形状改变而不改类；代价是多一层模板解析，面试范围内直接硬编码并说明这一点即可。
why_en: Layout is configuration rather than code, so a template string lets the output shape change without touching the class, at the cost of one parsing layer.
tradeoff: 模板字符串换免改代码 vs 硬编码换实现最简单
whenOtherWins: 面试时间紧就硬编码拼接，口头说明真实实现会在构造函数里接一个模板字符串，同样拿分。

termDefinitions.meaningEn: Formatter is a pure-function interface that serializes a LogRecord into a string; plain text and JSON are the two implementations.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次 log 调用生成的不可变值对象，携带 timestamp、level、message、threadName 四个字段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A LogRecord is the immutable value object created per log call, carrying timestamp, level, message, and thread name.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只负责把已格式化好的字符串写到具体目标（stdout、文件、未来的网络）的窄接口，不做过滤或格式化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Sink is a narrow interface that only writes an already formatted string to a target like stdout, a file, or the network.

termDefinitions.meaning: 带占位符的排版字符串，运行时把占位符替换成记录字段，改排版不用改代码。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A template string is a layout string with placeholders that are substituted with record fields at runtime, so changing layout needs no code change.
